title: MetalCytoToxDB per-metal LOMO AUC
description: Per-metal leave-one-metal-out (LOMO) AUC across the 5 precious metals in MetalCytoToxDB. Krasnov 2026 reports a single Ru subset 5-fold CV AUC = 0.81 (not per-metal LOMO); our per_fold_auc values below are LOMO with that metal held out.

series.name: Mol-Metal (LOMO, ours)
series.framing: LOMO per-metal: model trained on 4 metals, tested on held-out 5th metal. Honest gap to Krasnov 2026's single-metal Ru subset 5-fold CV.

series.name: Krasnov 2026 (MetalCytoToxDB)
series.note: Ru subset only; not per-metal LOMO protocol. Direct comparison apples-to-oranges, included as Tier-1 anchor.
